info.title: OSPF_Route
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

ospf_area.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Route](#/OSPF_Route)
OSPF Area to which the route belongs.

ospf_router.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Route](#/OSPF_Route)
OSPF Router to which the route belongs.

path.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Route](#/OSPF_Route)
The nexthop of the route. For example x.x.x.x/ifName (or) directly attached to ifName.

path_type.description: The value indicates whether the path type is inter-area, intra-area, or external.

prefix.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Route](#/OSPF_Route)
Specifies the prefix address in A.B.C.D/M format or border router-id in A.B.C.D format.

cost.description: The cost metric of the route.

ext_type.description: External Type 1 or Type 2 Route.  For External routes only.

spf_index.description: Internal number of the shortest path first (SPF) calculation that installs this route.

route_type.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Route](#/OSPF_Route)
Specifies the the type of the route. route_to_abr -> Specifies that this is a route to an Area Border Router route_to_asbr -> Specifies that this is a route to an Autonomous System Border Router route_to_abr_asbr -> Specifies that this is a route to an Area Border Router and Autonomous System Border Router route_to_prefix -> Specifies any route to a network.

vlink_route.description: This determines whether this is a route to virtual link.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: OSPF_Router.instance_tag
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
The list of all the OSPFv2 Router instances.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
